meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Netflix: hides the billboard, trailers, rows, match and rating badges, blurs or hides poster art, plus sign-up forms and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome, once with an iPhone UA and once with a desktop UA on https://www.netflix.com/ (it redirects to the regional landing page). Both UAs received the same responsive page, so one capture serves as both fixtures. Netflix does not show the logged-in catalogue to a logged-out visitor, so everything below is the marketing landing page only.

- **Sign-up forms**: `form[data-uia="email-form"]` 2 and `[data-uia="footer-signup"]` 1 (LIVE). The Sign In link (`[data-uia="header-login-link"]`) is never hidden.
- **Poster and hero art**: `[data-uia="hero-vlv"] img` 1 and `button[data-uia^="top-10-element-"] span[style*="background-image"]` 10 (LIVE); the posters are CSS background images, so only the box can be blurred.
- **Trending row** `[data-uia="nmhp-top-10"]` 1, **features and FAQ** `[data-uia="nmhp-full-value-props"]` 1 and `[data-uia="nmhp-faq"]` 1, **footer** `[data-uia="footer"]` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified (needs a login, which this project never uses): the browse page, the billboard trailer, Netflix Games rows, the title overlay when pausing, profiles. Community lists mention those, but no selector could be re-checked here, so none are included. Class names are hashed (`default-ltr-iqcdef-cache-...`) and are not used; selectors rely on `data-uia` values.

**Added 2026-11-17 (logged-in Browse, NOT live-verified)**: selectors come from public community sources, not from a capture, and are exercised only by the trimmed reconstruction `browse.html` / `desktop-browse.html`. Sources: uBlock Origin netflix.com filters (`.billboard-row`), bbbbbr/netflix-disable-auto-play-and-more, Greasy Fork "Netflix Disable Billboard Video" (`.billboard-motion`), the r/uBlockOrigin "Hiding Netflix Games" post (`.lolomoRow[data-list-context="popularGames"]`), JustZix Netflix examples (`data-list-context` values `queue`, `continueWatching`, `trending`, `becauseYouAdded`, `.volatile-billboard-animations-container`, `.previewModal--container`). The names `.match-score`, `.maturity-rating`, `.moreLikeThis--container`, `.previewModal--player_container`, `.boxart-image` and `.static-image` are recalled from community styles and could not be re-checked; Netflix renames classes without notice, so a rule that stops matching is expected to be silent. The hover preview shares its container with the details panel, so only its video is hidden. The logged-out Top 10 row stays under its own option.
